source_notes: the MCP registry example resolves an unpinned basic-memory package, so it is not the reproducible trial command
SECURITY.md still lists 0.x.x as supported even though v1.0.0 is released
current main differs from the reviewed release and is not carried into this gate

prerequisites: disposable project with constructed public data
Python 3.12 or later and an absolute reviewed uvx executable
wheel digest independently verified before execution
isolated config reviewed before it is written
project folder explicitly trusted when Bob folder trust is enabled
project MCP entry reviewed and enabled manually
prohibited_first_trial: global Bob or Basic Memory configuration mutation

runtime_side_effects_to_observe: wheel dependency resolution and any network access
project-local config, SQLite database, log and vector-index creation
FastEmbed model or cache downloads even when text search is selected
checksum conflict behavior across two writers
interrupted atomic write and index recovery
delete convergence across Markdown, history and indexes

contract_mapping.candidate_mechanism: explicit bm_read, bm_search and bm_context in the named project
required project arguments, MCP --project constraint and project-root validation
adapter-owned bm_write into a separately configured shared-lessons project
adapter-owned current marker plus immutable prior decision notes
adapter-owned source hash stored with the accepted evidence
bm_edit and bm_delete expected_checksum reject stale content with REVISION_CONFLICT
private atomic staging and SQLite/index recovery paths
notes are returned as data; adapter and Bob instructions must keep bodies inert
bm_delete removes notes with checksum guards; index and backup consequences require observation
adapter must return unavailable and point to repository evidence

stop_conditions: source pin or wheel digest differs
runtime resolves an unreviewed Basic Memory release
server requires global Bob or Basic Memory configuration
server uses cloud routing or exposes a non-STDIO transport
stored instruction-like content changes control flow
backend failure is reported as successful recall
direct and indexed deletion cannot be demonstrated
the trial would require private data, credentials or a paid model call
unverified: wheel dependency closure and supply-chain behavior
live Bob discovery, activation, approval and tool use
durable multi-process concurrency and interruption recovery
backup erasure, privacy compliance, AGPL deployment obligations and production readiness
